headline: EU FSD bloc-wide vote set for July 2026 at earliest — no vote scheduled this week; Tesla faces Nordic bloc skepticism over speeding allowance, icy road performance, and hands-free driving at 80 km/h; TCMV requires 55% of member states + 65% of EU population to approve; Reuters/Ars Technica/Electrek report October 2026 as likely backup date; Netherlands now sharing approval details via non-public regulatory exchange; individual nations may provisionally approve ahead of bloc-wide vote; Tesla needs 15 of 27 EU member states to say yes

Austin robotaxi begins unsupervised evening operation for first time — fleet previously limited to daytime hours ending by mid-afternoon; now operating into evening hours per RtaxiTracker; 47.8% of Austin trips were unsupervised in the last 7 days (up from <30% weeks prior); Sunday set new high for unsupervised sightings with 7 new vehicles spotted across Dallas, Houston, and Austin; operational envelope expansion signals growing FSD confidence across varied lighting and traffic conditions
source: Not a Tesla App / RtaxiTracker / Teslarati

headline: SpaceX formally files plan revealing Terafab chip factory costs $55B–$119B — joint Tesla/SpaceX semiconductor facility in Texas enters formal planning phase; research fab at Giga Texas (~$3B) will produce AI5-class chips in small batches; full Terafab scope $55B minimum with total exceeding $119B; Intel 14A process confirmed; SpaceX filing notes 'no assurance' on timeline execution; one of the largest private infrastructure investments in history if fully built

Germany April 2026 best April ever for Tesla — 3,149 units, 1.3% overall market share, 4.9% of BEV segment; BEV national penetration hit 25.8%; +256% YoY vs April 2025, +142% vs January 2026; highest first-month-of-quarter since Q1 2024 (9 quarters); YTD already at 82% of full-year 2025 total; last 3 months +188% vs Nov–Jan; EU recovery now structural across all major markets

Tesla files two new Roadster trademarks with USPTO — stylized wordmark + distinctive triangular badge filed May 1, 2026; badge departs sharply from Tesla's standard T-bar identity; Electrek calls it 'clearest signal yet' Tesla is preparing to bring the long-delayed supercar to market; aligns with Musk's 'month or so' reveal hint from Apr 23 earnings call; summer 2026 unveil now appears imminent

Tesla recalls 218,868 vehicles (Model 3, Y, S, X) over rearview camera delay — NHTSA confirms software bug in build 2026.8.6 causes backup camera image to delay up to 11 seconds, increasing crash risk; OTA remedy issued free of charge; no injuries reported; resolved remotely without physical service visit

Tesla Semi filmed hauling first Cybercab delivery batch out of Giga Texas — multiple Cybercabs secured on flatbed trailer being transported by a production-spec Semi (82,000 lbs GCW); follows 60 units staged in outbound lot on Apr 30; first documented delivery run confirms Cybercab manufacturing cadence advancing from pilot builds to active distribution; units likely heading to fleet staging and testing sites

Tesla China-made EV sales jump 36% YoY in April to 79,478 units — sixth consecutive monthly gain as recovery accelerates from 2025 lows; figures include GigaShanghai exports to Europe and other markets; Reuters notes FSD approval delays and aggressive Chinese rival launches as potential limits on further momentum; Q2 delivery pace now well above Q2 2025 baseline

WattEV orders 370 Tesla Semi trucks in $100M deal — California's largest-ever single electric truck order; 50 units to be delivered in 2026 with full fleet by end of 2027; 300+ trucks supporting Port of Oakland freight electrification; WattEV CEO said Tesla Semi was chosen based on 'cost, performance, and availability' in a public RFP process — signals accelerating enterprise fleet adoption as Nevada production ramps

Tesla wins S&P Global Mobility 'Overall Loyalty to Make' award for 4th consecutive year — owners returning to Tesla brand at class-leading rates despite Musk political controversy; structural brand loyalty floor confirmed even amid DOGE-related demand headwinds; loyalty data validates that product quality continues to outweigh political backlash
